partition.ids: opaque; equality only; numerical value, order, sign, and cardinality never imply semantics

central_image.representation: shared_adapter_central_image.v1: image-only decoded central source plane, whole-FOV shared masked-area transform, before FreeMask/CUTS/DFC normalization

allowed_input.geometry: shared-grid and validity metadata only; anatomical orientation is disabled in v1

component_graph.raw_cluster_id_use: preserved only as opaque provenance and equality relation; excluded from ranking, semantic hashes, and tie breaking
component_graph.component_definition: maximal 4-connected pixels having equal opaque raw cluster ID
component_graph.adjacency_definition: number of unordered horizontal or vertical pixel pairs belonging to distinct components
component_graph.border_contact_definition: component contains a pixel with row in {0,H-1} or col in {0,W-1}
component_graph.hole_definition: a maximal 4-connected component of the complement of A that has no border pixel
component_graph.enclosure_definition: A encloses B iff A and B are distinct non-border components, adjacency(A,B)>0, and every pixel of B lies in the union of A's holes

background.seed: the unique maximum-area candidate; if absent or tied, no BG assignment and all border candidates receive ambiguous_bg
background.merge: assign BG to the seed and every border-touching component with the same opaque raw-ID equality class as the seed; no distinct raw-ID background merge is allowed in v1

lv_myo.candidate_pairs: ordered pairs (A,B) satisfying enclosure_definition after BG assignment
lv_myo.resolution: if exactly one pair exists, assign A=MYO and B=LV; if zero, relevant non-BG components remain VOID with missing_enclosed_cavity; if more than one, every member of every candidate pair remains VOID with ambiguous_enclosure
lv_myo.merge: additional components may map MYO only when they independently form the same unique resolved enclosure pair; this v1 rule therefore normally yields one MYO component

rv.candidate_set: non-BG components that are not the resolved LV, are not MYO, are not fully inside a MYO hole, and have adjacency(MYO,C)>0
rv.resolution: if exactly one candidate exists, assign it RV; if zero, RV is unsupported; if more than one, every RV candidate remains VOID with ambiguous_rv

intensity_policy.reason: cross-site MRI ordering and inversion are not established; constant or tied intensity must not resolve anatomy
intensity_policy.allowed_future_use: only versioned relative within-image diagnostics after a separately frozen revision

orientation_policy.reason: current manifest orientation validity does not prove a common short-axis patient-direction convention

tie_policy: no raw-ID, raster-order, method, dataset, patient, intensity, or orientation tie break

cardinality_policy.K=1: only uniquely supported BG may be assigned; otherwise VOID
cardinality_policy.K=2: BG may be assigned; no MYO/LV enclosure plus RV can be inferred
cardinality_policy.K=3: a unique BG/MYO/LV enclosure may be assigned; RV remains VOID if unsupported; DFC MinL3 never receives a manufactured fourth region
cardinality_policy.K=4: roles are assigned only by unique topology, never by K
cardinality_policy.K>4: many-to-one assignment is permitted only by the explicit BG or enclosure rules; all other components are VOID

void_policy.validity_encoding: boolean; true iff semantic encoding is not VOID
